metadata.title: Concircular Sections Along Submanifolds
metadata.abstract: We introduce an equation which generalises that of a concircular vector field to sections of the ambient tangent bundle along submanifolds. Totally umbilic hypersurfaces and various overdetermined systems (such as Obata's and Tashiro's equations) are obtained as specific cases. Given an ambient manifold $M$ and a connected submanifold $P$ of dimension at least $2$, the solution space $W(P;M)$ is shown to have dimension at most $\mathrm{dim } M+1$ with all solutions being of `special type' whenever it exceeds $\mathrm{codim } P+1$. This bound is shown to be sharp. When the submanifold $P$ is simply connected we show the maximum dimension is attained exactly when $P$ has constant sectional curvature $\kappa$ relative to the ambient manifold $M$. In the case of maximum dimension we introduce a bilinear form $\mathbb{I}$ on $W(P;M)$ which is Riemannian, degenerate or Lorentzian, depending on the sign of $\kappa$ and show $P$ immerses into $(W(P;M),\mathbb{I})$'s unit quadric. Hence our main result shows that whenever $P$ is simply connected, has dimension of at least $2$, and has constant curvature $\kappa\neq0$ relative to its ambient manifold $M$, there is an isometric immersion (which we construct explicitly) of $P$ with its metric induced from $M$, into the $\mathrm{dim } M$-dimensional space form of curvature $\kappa$.
